mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, proxied by HOUST, leads to higher corporate earnings expectations and accelerates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST growth exceeds +2% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment, measured by PAYEMS, reduces labor market uncertainty and boosts investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS rising by > 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening supply-side constraints, prompting market participants to price in higher future growth and generating positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no correlation with INDPRO declines (Spearman's rho < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a month, the market anticipates higher future rates, shortening discount rates and producing negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25% in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS increase exceeding 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising unemployment (UNRATE) trigger a 'labor market cooling' narrative that reduces growth expectations and drives negative 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE declines by < 0.5% over the period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in both consumer (HOUST) and business (RSAFS) demand creates a dual momentum effect that drives positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are flat or negative despite both HOUST and RSAFS rising by > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent FEDFUNDS above 4%, the market expects higher future discount rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when FEDFUNDS stays above 4% for the entire 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) followed by a rebound (same month + 2%) signals a supply shock recovery, generating positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO drops > -2% in a month then rebounds > 0% in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day returns show no significant improvement relative to the prior month's baseline (p > 0.05).
